mapper.select: SELECT penalty_calculate_no AS penaltyCalculateNo, ent_ceo_no AS entCeoNo, ent_emp_id AS entEmpId, sell_products_no AS sellProductsNo, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, penalty_fee_ratio AS penaltyFeeRatio, register_date AS registerDate, revision_date AS revisionDate, use_status AS useStatus FROM ent_penalty_calculate WHERE sell_products_no = #{sellProductsNo}
